prose: Bloomberg reports Pigment, a French startup whose AI-powered software helps businesses forecast finances, spin up slide decks, and more, has raised $250 million at a $2.3 billion valuation. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: French startup: AI software for financial forecasting, decks, and planning
Bloomberg notes Nvidia backing; framed as challenging Microsoft
